blocks.text: At times, Zscaler Support might need access to your Zscaler Admin Console for a limited period to troubleshoot issues. Remote assistance allows Zscaler Support to securely and remotely log in to the portal. This can be done with either view-only or full admin privileges.
This procedure allows Zscaler Support to access the portal until the specified date.

blocks.item: Log in to the Zscaler Admin Console.
Go to Help > Tools & Resources > Remote Assistance.
In the Remote Assistance window, select your access preferences and User Name Visibility.
Select Allow Remote Assistance, then select View Only, Full Access (Read/Write), or both.

After enabling your access preferences, select the amount of time you want the access enabled. Zscaler recommends that you select a length of at least one year when choosing view-only access and at least two days when choosing full access.
Select Obfuscate Data if desired. By default, this is set to off.
Admins with Remote Assistance Management enabled for their role can make changes in the Remote Assistance window.
